files.bangladesh-divisions.geojson: 8 divisions dissolved from the 64 BBS/OCHA districts (so all levels nest exactly)
files.bangladesh-districts.geojson: 64 districts, geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM2 (simplified), BBS pcodes attached
files.bangladesh-upazilas.geojson: 544 upazilas/thanas, geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM3 (simplified), BBS pcodes attached
files.bangladesh-unions.topojson: 5,160 unions, geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM4 (simplified, TopoJSON); IDs are <upazila pcode>-U<nnn>, not official BBS codes
files.bangladesh-country.geojson: National outline from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); see country-source-metadata.json

boundarySource: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) and OCHA ROAP, via geoBoundaries
boundaryLicense: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
sourceDataset: HDX: Administrative boundaries of Bangladesh as of 2015
replaced: Until 2026-11-13 the division layer was geoBoundaries ADM1 from Wikimedia Commons (CC0). It differed from the BBS districts by 5-24% of each division's area and was replaced.
